scoring_justification: Cannot recompute absolute barriers from raw DFT outputs because verifier sandbox lacks DFT results; compare reported barriers to paper gold with tolerance appropriate for method variation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference activation barriers for four reactions on AlH cluster
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported values; the reference solve.sh reproduces them and full credit ensures correctness.

outputs.description: Computed activation barriers for hydrogen exchange, cracking (path 1), dehydrogenation, and hydride transfer on the AlH zeolite cluster. Values in kJ/mol.

output_contract.notes: The ordering hydrogen_exchange < hydride_transfer < cracking ≈ dehydrogenation is verified by the hidden checker, but not required to be stated in the output.
